description: Read the exact authorized terms, terms hash, order state and processor payment links, and the thread the business published on the offer: its answers to counteroffers (thread.counteroffers), the purchasing requirements, vendor status and purchase order matches it holds (thread.purchasing), and the portions, shortfall and remedies of delivery (thread.fulfilment). Use the offer link credentials, or credentials of the request explicitly linked to this offer.
